articles.title: She Walked 1,400 Miles to Make Juneteenth a National Holiday — at Age 89
articles.summary: Opal Lee, now 99, spent decades pushing for Juneteenth to become a federal holiday. In 2016, she led a symbolic walk from Fort Worth to DC, covering 2.5 miles per city. Her activism paid off in 2021.

articles.title: Rivian's CEO on Cybertruck's Failure, Ferrari's Surprise, and the High-Stakes Bet on R2
articles.summary: In a candid interview, Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe called the Cybertruck 'very niche,' praised Ferrari's Luce interior, and revealed that the company's future hinges on the mass-market R2 SUV. If it flops, Rivian must radically restructure.

articles.title: Sam Short Sweeps Distance Freestyles, Sets Textile World Record at Aussie Trials
articles.summary: Sam Short won the 200, 400, 800, and 1500 free at the 2026 Australian Trials, becoming the first man since Grant Hackett in 2005 to achieve the sweep. He also broke the textile world record in the 800 free.
